summary: Describes content splicing for RTP sessions, where part of a main media stream is replaced with other content for a while, such as a local advertisement replacing a national one. The memo covers the mechanisms and signaling involved. It is informational.

eli5.summary: During a TV show, the usual advert is swapped for one from your town, then the show carries on. This explains how that swap works over the internet.

questions: how does rtp content splicing work
how to insert local ads into a media stream
